name: draft
label: Draft models: live LoRA adaptation from the main model's replies, agreement measured

defaults._doc: Helper llama-server processes beside the main one (aux_servers.py). Slot model names are as /api/tags lists them (a trailing .gguf is accepted). Any slot value may be ${ENV_NAME}, filled from the container environment (docker-compose.yml / .env) - an unset name skips that slot with a log line. Slot args go to llama-server as given; -c sets the context the agreement measurement trims prompts to. The trainer runs per round with these args; {model} {data} {ctx} {threads} {lora_out} {lora_in} are filled in. Check train.args against `llama-finetune-lora --help` on first start - the startup log warns about flags --help does not mention. yield_to_main: draft evaluation and trainer starts wait while the main model is answering a request.

train._doc: text: reply = train on the main model's reply text only; prompt+reply also trains on the rendered prompt (only correct if the trainer parses the template's special tokens). stop_server frees the slot's memory while its trainer runs. parallel = rounds that may train at the same time. A round starts only when free memory (container limit aware, minus trainers already running) covers model file size x mem_factor + min_free_gb; otherwise it is logged as round_skipped and retried on the next sample. mem_factor is an estimate (frozen base + F32 adapter + backprop buffers at ctx) - correct it from the trainer's peak use in round_NNNN.log.
